thread:
sara.j: Hi team, trying to finish onboarding but I cant join the eng Google group or accept the 1Password invite. When I try to join eng@redwood.ai it says "No such group or you're not permitted". Anyone seen this?
onboarding-bot: Welcome sara.j!
onboarding-bot: Provisioning log: account_create sara.j processed; alias_detected=sara.j.personal@redwood.ai; status=pending_groups.
chris.it: Hey @sara.j - quick Q: did you accept the welcome email with the primary corporate address or the alias? sometimes migration creates a secondary alias that blocks group membership.
sara.j: I accepted the link that came to sara.j.personal@redwood.ai (forwarded from personal) because my corp email looked like a resend and had an odd token.
jamie.peopleops: Ahhh that explains it. Your account was created but the primary attribute is the personal alias, which our group sync ignores. @chris.it can you reassign the primary email to sara.j@redwood.ai and force a directory sync?
chris.it: On it. I'll flip the primary and run a syncjob now. ETA ~2m.
chris.it: syncjob started.
chris.it: syncjob complete. Changed primaryEmail=sara.j@redwood.ai, cleared duplicate alias. Can you try joining the group again?
sara.j: Tried — still can't see the group in Gmail's groups list but I can open the link now and it shows "request pending approval".
chris.it: Approving request now. Also resent 1Password invite to primary email.
jamie.peopleops: note: updating onboarding checklist to call out potential alias confusion for cross-org transfers.
sara.j: Got the 1Password invite and accepted. When I attempt to register a passkey it errors with "passkey not allowed for this account" — is that an org policy?
chris.it: We had a temporary block on passkeys for accounts with alias history. I removed the block for your user. Try logging out of 1Password and back in, then go to Account > Security > Add device.
sara.j: Worked! Passkey registered, and I'm in the eng Google group now. Thanks everyone. 
jamie.peopleops: Welcome aboard @sara.j :tada: — assigning a buddy and adding you to the #eng channel. Ping me if anything else pops up.
